tier: prospective read-only secondary analysis of frozen historical development artifacts
authorization: The user explicitly authorized the reviewed historical single-P morphology re-audit after the frozen dense-alpha add-back closed with no constrained rescue.
question: Did either frozen historical alpha-bearing single-P family already satisfy the later constrained Liu morphology standard, or did the historical success claims concern only the earlier core-behavior and compensation gates?
claim_boundary: This study reads archived arrays and JSON only. It performs no training, checkpoint loading, model inference, choice resampling, temperature or margin rescaling, threshold search, model selection, or mutation of a parent record.
The two historical families are reported separately. Participants remain nested within seed-panel-condition units and are never pooled as independent networks.

The primary units are every clean-trained acute-noisy Ae cell from local_memory_removal and every clean_no_time clean-trained acute-noisy Ae cell from clean_single_p. Their matched A0 cells are mandatory clean-observation controls.

Historical five-core and compensation success is not relabeled as all-nine or constrained morphology. The audit applies the later definitions prospectively and preserves the original claim boundaries.

The common morphology calculation is identical across families, but inherited competence is checked against each archived unit rather than retrospectively imposing the later M2 generic panel contract. Cross-family comparisons are therefore descriptive, not a controlled alpha effect.

A successful historical precedent would establish existence within an exposed development recipe, not population reliability, human neural implementation, alpha causality, or promotion of a historical checkpoint.

A null result would reject only the proposition that these archived historical success cells met the later constrained pair-morphology standard; it would not invalidate their registered core-behavior or compensation findings.

design.unit: One historical family, seed, panel, and observation condition. Every unit is retained; no seed, panel, participant cohort, or pair is selected after exposure.
design.exposure_barrier: Freeze the protocol, qualify the implementation on synthetic fixtures, and lock all 36 archived units before computing any new morphology summary. Analyze all units before writing the canonical result.

qualification.artifact_completeness: Require raw.npz, behavior.json, result.json, and completed run.json for all 36 mandatory units, plus both parent protocols and canonical results.
qualification.choice_replay: Deterministically reconstruct every subject-by-pair ten-choice accuracy from archived intact and local-off logits, the original query schedule, choice seed, and temperature. Require exact equality with both stored full and global behaviors and pair-mean error at most 1e-12.
qualification.latent_parity: Recompute canonical fields, exact correct probabilities, and Hodge potentials from archived logits; require maximum absolute error at most 1e-12 against archived arrays.
qualification.hodge_identity: Require field equals gradient plus residual within 1e-12 and gradient-residual inner products within 1e-10 times total field energy.
qualification.interface_identity: Require protocol_id liu_v2, 77 subjects, temperature 0.25, 56 oriented logits, eight relation-removal arrays, and the unchanged historical nine-row identities in every unit.
qualification.no_model_execution: Qualification and analysis may load typed NPZ and JSON only. Importing Torch or loading a checkpoint is forbidden.
qualification.synthetic_tests: Before artifact exposure, fixtures cover replay parity, all morphology stages, threshold inclusivity, all-nine and bad-pair decisions, paired A0-to-Ae error inflation, family-level outcome labels, and Hodge reconstruction.

estimands.analysis_cohort: Reuse the frozen cohort in each behavior.json: sampled overall accuracy at least 0.5 and sampled ranking class not correct.
estimands.behavior: Report inherited generic competence, full-route Liu competence, evidence binding, each of the nine qualitative rows, and all-nine status without changing historical thresholds.
pair_morphology: diagnostic latent and archived sampled bimodal pairs
strong-error subject prevalence and top-five-pair share
latent and sampled morphology plus strong-error tail mass by symbolic distance 1, 2, 3, and 4+
absolute and sign-changing effects of each archived support-relation removal
estimands.current_standard_unit: An Ae unit is constrained when inherited generic competence and full-route Liu competence pass, evidence binding passes, all nine qualitative rows pass, latent_bimodal_pairs and sampled_bimodal_pairs are each at least 15, and no sampled ordinary-unimodal or low-accuracy pair is present.
estimands.error_inflation_unit: An Ae unit is error-inflated when its sampled bimodal-pair count exceeds its matched A0 control and either all-nine fails or an ordinary-unimodal or low-accuracy sampled pair is present.
estimands.family_replication: A family has a replicated current-standard precedent only when every one of its three historical seeds has at least one of three Ae panels constrained. This mirrors the original per-seed at-least-one-panel topology while replacing the earlier five-core gate with the later constrained gate.

unit_stage: direction_absent when direction-present pairs are below 15
weak_margin when direction-present pairs are at least 15 but strong two-sided pairs are below 15
latent_shape when strong two-sided pairs are at least 15 but latent bimodal pairs are below 15
finite_sampling when latent bimodal pairs are at least 15 but sampled bimodal pairs are below 15
already_latent_and_sampled when latent and sampled bimodal pairs are both at least 15

outcomes.cross_family_current_standard_precedent: Both historical families meet the registered family-replication rule.
outcomes.single_family_current_standard_precedent: Exactly one historical family meets the registered family-replication rule.
outcomes.isolated_current_standard_precedent: At least one Ae unit is constrained, but neither family meets the family-replication rule.
outcomes.no_current_standard_precedent: Zero of the 18 primary Ae units are constrained.
outcomes.noninterpretable: A mandatory artifact, replay, latent parity, interface, finiteness, or Hodge integrity check fails.

decision.stop: Freeze one canonical JSON result, one compact NPZ pair table, and one concise interpretation report, then stop. Do not train, tune alpha, alter a historical record, promote a checkpoint, or initiate an initialization factorial under this protocol.

execution.runtime: CPU-only typed NumPy/JSON analysis; one BLAS thread; no Torch or checkpoint import.
freeze_points: Commit and push this protocol and initial native study registration before implementing or exposing new morphology outcomes.
Commit and push the qualified implementation plus a source/input lock covering all mandatory historical artifacts before analysis.
Analyze all mandatory units without inspecting partial summaries, freeze the canonical result, pair table, and report, commit and push, then stop.
execution.retention: Track the protocol, qualification, source/input lock, compact pair table, canonical result, and concise report. Reuse historical artifacts by verified reference and do not duplicate or delete raw arrays or checkpoints.
